newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat seen one to three cents higher.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat seen one to three cents higher.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures were expected to open one to three cents per bushel higher Tuesday on forecasts showing unfavorable harvest conditions in U.S. Southern Plains states, traders said.
"There are concerns over quality and a lack of harvest activity," said one floor trader.
The National Weather Service's latest six- to 10-day report showed below-normal temperatures and above-normal precipitation for much of Oklahoma and Texas.
Bearish traders noted that the weekly crop ratings for winter wheat from USDA showed an improvement in the crop.
USDA rated the winter wheat crop 54 percent good or excellent, 31 percent fair, 10 percent poor and four percent very poor.
